description:
REVIEWED 2026-10-25 (TodoReview) against origin/develop 9a184b619 and fork main ea44bcc9 (30.24.0.13). PROBLEM (unchanged): the six published TPC-DS OBT SF1 bundles ran with parameters set to `0` instead of dsqgen's values. Their sidecars carry `known_defects: ["defective-tpcds-obt-parameters"]`, so the explorer marks them `known_defective_data` and leaves them out of rankings (`python results-data/validate_corpus.py` lists ('tpcds_obt', '1.0') as an UNRANKED cohort). Rerun each platform once at SF1 on OBT version 0.2, validate, and publish the new bundles; retire the defective ones or keep them as comparison-only history per results-data/DEFECTIVE_DATAGEN_AUDIT.md.

VERIFIED FACTS (2026-10-25)
- The six bundles exist and carry the sidecar flag: tpcds_obt_sf1_bigquery_sql_20260923_152357_480ffcea, ..._clickhouse_local_sql_20260826_171140_836c988b, ..._databricks_sql_20261001_192224_d11b3297, ..._datafusion_sql_20260826_164619_4e6d3fff, ..._duckdb_sql_20260826_162433_2a6932b1, ..._snowflake_sql_20261001_173028_d35974f6.
- The prerequisite tpcds-obt-empty-queries-conversion-20261017 is DONE (finished 2026-10-22); OBT version 0.2 serves 90 of 99 queries (Q8, Q54, Q84 and inventory queries are recorded exclusions). `make tpcds-obt-equivalence` compares every served query with TPC-DS on DuckDB only; SF1 lists `UNVERIFIABLE_AT_SF_1 = {23, 24}` (empty base results), so two served queries cannot be proven by it.
- That equivalence test never runs other engines, and its emptiness rule misses one-row zero/NULL aggregates (see sql-execution-gate-vacuous-empty-results-20261025). Cross-engine correctness of the reruns is therefore judged by comparing each platform's per-query results with the DuckDB OBT run on the same data, not by that test.
- OBT Q16/Q94/Q95 use dsqgen `[YEAR]-[MONTH]-01` unpadded date literals (fixed for SQLite only, #3426). ClickHouse Local handling is unconfirmed (questdb-unpadded-date-cast-null-20261025 covers the matrix). At SF1 TPC-DS has 5 warehouses, so these queries should be non-vacuous there; verify.
- Cloud text may still change: Snowflake/BigQuery/Databricks emit explicit NULLS LAST (snowflake-databricks-desc-nulls-last-audit-20261025); re-recording cloud OBT SQL before that audit risks a second paid rerun.

DECISION GATES (stop and ask the owner)
G1 Spend. BigQuery, Databricks and Snowflake reruns need explicit approval with an estimate each; Snowflake also needs a new account (the trial is closed): account creation is an owner action. Recommended order: local three first, cloud three only after G2.
G2 Cloud timing. Recommended default: start the cloud reruns after the NULLS LAST audit decision lands (or the owner accepts re-recording risk).
G3 ClickHouse Local gate: do not publish the ClickHouse Local OBT rerun until Q16/Q94/Q95 are shown non-vacuous and equal to DuckDB's (counts, shipping cost, net profit), or the ClickHouse unpadded-date matrix row is confirmed.
G4 Disposition of the six defective bundles after replacement: keep as flagged comparison-only history (recommended; precedent in DEFECTIVE_DATAGEN_AUDIT.md) versus retire. Publishing the replacements is a separate production step requiring owner approval.
G5 Unexpected results (row counts differing across platforms, a query that now returns nothing): stop and ask.

GUARDRAILS
- No cloud spend or publication without explicit approval; never edit the published bundle JSON; sidecar and CORPUS_NOTES only.
- Do not rerun OBT on a version other than 0.2 or with the old parameter handling; do not hand-edit OBT queries to change results.
- Local reruns: one heavy run at a time, output outside the repo (BENCHBOX_OUTPUT_DIR=~/Developer/benchmark_runs); DuckDB reference run first.
- Do not relax the validator or `validate_corpus.py` to admit the bundles.

STANDING GUARDRAILS: work only in a `make worktree-create` worktree after `make agent-write-preflight` (primary clone /Users/joe/Developer/BenchBox is read-only); run tests only through make targets (`make test-fast`, `make pr-preflight`, `make sql-execution-gate`, `make tpcds-obt-equivalence`) or targeted `uv run -- python -m pytest <paths> -n 4`; never BENCHBOX_TEST_LOCK_DIR, `make test-unlock` or raw broad runs; one heavy run at a time; no live-cloud spend and no production publish without explicit owner approval; published result bundles are never edited (only manifest-sidecar `known_defects` and results-data/CORPUS_NOTES.md per results-data/DEFECTIVE_DATAGEN_AUDIT.md); no SKIP / --no-verify / `git add -A`; no explanatory comments or docstrings in code (`make comment-policy-check`); uv only; identity Joe Harris, no Co-Authored-By; PR flow `make pr-preflight` once, `make pr-open`, CI + oracle review, `make pr-arm`. Stop and ask the owner on unexpected result changes, relaxed guards, oracle stand-ins or real design choices.
